levels.surface: عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الدارمي

notes: Alqama and Aswad are the two transmitters of the scene; Ibn Mas'ud is the one whose words («هكذا فعل رسول الله») the report relays, so he is the last link (rule 6)
«عبد الله» at occurrence 2 is the Companion; occurrence 1 is the first link's name
